title: UTF-8 Validation
description: Determine if a sequence of integers represents a valid UTF-8 encoding.

steps.note: Initialize count to 0 to track remaining continuation bytes.
Check prefix 110: byte 197 matches 2-byte sequence start.
Set count to 1 for the next continuation byte.
Count is 1, check if prefix is 10.
Valid continuation byte, decrement count to 0.
Finished loop, count is 0, return true.
